items.name: deep-teach
items.desc: Eight thinking frameworks applied in sequence — first principles, Feynman, chunking, inversion, MECE, memory lock — ending in an exam answer written from memory.

items.name: project-chronicle
items.desc: Records a project's whole history as it happens. Problem, options, decisions, MVP scope — and every attempt that failed, kept on purpose.

items.name: Second brain
items.desc: The skill layer beneath a knowledge wiki that rewrites itself.

items.name: AI Brain
items.desc: A personal wiki CLI with AI-powered context and personas. Desktop app on top.

items.name: postiee
items.desc: Post to LinkedIn from the terminal, for people who live there anyway.

items.name: olx-india-cli
items.desc: Search, score and track second-hand cars with model-scored recommendations.

items.name: second-brain
items.desc: A knowledge wiki that evolves with you, built to run inside any CLI agent.

items.name: Clipper
items.desc: A clipboard watch-later for Windows. A hotkey captures any URL or screenshot, Claude Code classifies it into structured notes in your Obsidian vault, and a local dashboard indexes everything. No cloud, no account, no telemetry.

items.name: AI Brain Desktop
items.desc: The second brain with a face — an Electron desktop app wrapping the AI-powered wiki in a chat interface over the same multi-provider backend.

items.name: OLX India Web
items.desc: The browser side of olx-india-cli — search and track second-hand cars with AI-scored recommendations. Shares a backend with the terminal tool.

items.name: Executive Assistant
items.desc: A personal assistant agent that holds the calendar and the loose ends. Built for the work between the meetings, not the meetings themselves.

items.name: Healthcare AI Agent
items.desc: Clinical decision support across patient records — an earlier branch being rebuilt on the current stack before it returns to this page.

items.name: BlockAuth
items.desc: Blockchain-based authentication. One-time passwords anchor an identity to an on-chain record, so the credential cannot be replayed once it is used.

items.name: ColdTrust
items.desc: A Hyperledger Fabric smart contract for cold-chain supply records — every custody handoff written to a shared, tamper-evident ledger.

items.name: ChainTrace
items.desc: Self-hostable forensic tracing: follow stolen funds hop by hop and profile any wallet. Neo4j graph, self-hosted, open source.

items.name: EVM Log Extractor
items.desc: Pulls structured evidence out of raw on-chain event logs, so an investigation starts from parsed data rather than raw RPC output.

items.name: Border Payment
items.desc: A cross-border payment rail that settles where correspondent banking stops being economical — moving value between jurisdictions without a chain of intermediaries each taking a cut.

items.name: ChainSentinel
items.desc: ChainSentinel from Project Hail Mary. Investigate on-chain exploits end to end, from the attack transaction to the drained funds.

items.name: ForensicTool W3
items.desc: A TypeScript toolkit for web3 forensic investigation workflows — parsing, tracing and evidence assembly in one place.

items.name: Attack Logs
items.desc: An EVM attack simulation dataset — 36 documented smart-contract exploits with forensic-grade NDJSON logs, usable as ground truth for detection work.

items.name: Axiom
items.desc: Evidence-grounded clinical intelligence layer for EMRs — calibrated refusal when the record cannot support an answer. Hackathon District 04.

items.name: Web3 Forensics Research
items.desc: A self-guided research archive: the tool landscape, an enterprise architecture blueprint, and editable diagrams.

sections.title: Projects
sections.blurb: standalone builds, each shipped on its own

items.name: Health Lovely
items.desc: A full-stack health platform on Next.js and Supabase — components, contexts, migrations and middleware wired together rather than a scaffold.

items.name: Healthcare Tracker
items.desc: Tracks a patient over time instead of one consultation. Its own migrations, hook layer and docs directory for the data model.

items.name: Prawn Diagnosis
items.desc: A Next.js diagnostic tool built as a real application with its own app router, components and styling pipeline.

items.name: Shrimp Git
items.desc: A Git tool built around a Node backend and a documented command set, aimed at making history inspection less painful than the default tooling.

items.name: Investment
items.desc: A portfolio and stock-basket application split into a dedicated frontend and backend, so the two halves can evolve independently.

items.name: Club Rank
items.desc: A rankings platform with a Go backend and its own frontend, planned and documented before it was written — the plan documents are part of the repo.

items.name: Clean Energy Project
items.desc: A clean and green energy web project built for an open elective, covering renewable data and energy transitions.

items.name: Resume Builder
items.desc: A Java application for building and editing résumés, the one build in the collection that is deliberately not web-based.

items.name: Elasticsearch Tool
items.desc: A Python toolkit for building and querying Elasticsearch indexes, with its own indexing and search surface.

items.name: Web3 Log Simulation
items.desc: Simulates on-chain event logs so a forensic workflow can be rehearsed without touching a live network.

items.name: Admin Abuse Simulation
items.desc: A Solidity model of an administrative-abuse scenario, written as a study of what goes wrong when privileged actions are not constrained.

items.name: Stripe Stablecoin
items.desc: A bridge from fiat rails to stablecoin settlement — the on-ramp experiment behind the Border Payment rail.

items.name: Agent101
items.desc: What an agent actually is, through to shipping one that holds up against a real model. Built for people who have read the docs and still don't get it.
